depends_on.name: software_id
depends_on.documentation: The implementation that applies this rule (the v1 filenavigator class name became an edge, not a string field).

fields.name: data_file_pattern
fields.documentation: Which files comprise ONE epoch, as declared patterns ({'#\\.rhd\\>', '#\\.tsv\\>'}). PARSED, never eval'd: the v1 form was a string handed to eval. `#` matches an unknown common stem, so a group of files sharing it is one epoch.

fields.name: epoch_map_pattern
fields.documentation: Which of the epoch's files is the probe-map file ({'(.*)epochprobemap.ndi'}). Same parsed-not-eval'd rule.

fields.name: epoch_map_format
fields.documentation: How to parse the probe-map file ('ndi.epoch.epochprobemap_daqsystem').
